description: AlphaFold pLDDT and PAE for LONRF3: confidence of RING placement relative to TPR, LON and the 410-430 loop
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, json, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# pLDDT per residue + PAE
p='struct/AF-Q496Y0.pdb'
pl={}
for l in open(p):
    if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        pl[int(l[22:26])]=float(l[60:66])
plddt=pd.Series(pl).sort_index()
if not os.path.exists('struct/pae.json'):
    r=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q496Y0-F1-predicted_aligned_error_v6.json',timeout=240)
    open('struct/pae.json','w').write(r.text)
pae=np.array(json.load(open('struct/pae.json'))[0]['predicted_aligned_error'])
print('PAE matrix', pae.shape)
def blk(a,b,c,d):
    A=slice(a-1,b); B=slice(c-1,d)
    return (pae[A,B].mean()+pae[B,A].mean())/2
R1=(158,195); R2=(467,504); TPR=(55,120); LOOP=(410,430); LON=(546,755); TPRc=(243,344)
print('mean pLDDT: RING1 %.1f | RING2 %.1f | TPR 55-120 %.1f | loop 410-430 %.1f | LON %.1f'%(
    plddt[158:196].mean(), plddt[467:505].mean(), plddt[55:121].mean(), plddt[410:431].mean(), plddt[546:756].mean()))
print('inter-domain PAE (A, lower=more confident relative placement):')
for nm,(a,b),(c,d) in [('RING1<->TPR(55-120)',R1,TPR),('RING1<->RING2',R1,R2),('RING2<->loop410-430',R2,LOOP),
                        ('RING2<->LON',R2,LON),('RING1<->LON',R1,LON),('RING2<->TPR2(243-344)',R2,TPRc)]:
    print(f'   {nm:26s} {blk(a,b,c,d):.1f}')

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,5))
ax=axes[0]
ax.plot(plddt.index, plddt.values, lw=0.8, color='#444')
for (a,b),c,lab in [((158,195),'#d62728','RING1'),((467,504),'#1f77b4','RING2'),((546,755),'#2ca02c','LON-N'),((410,430),'#ff7f0e','loop 410-430')]:
    ax.axvspan(a,b,color=c,alpha=0.25); ax.text((a+b)/2, 103, lab, ha='center', fontsize=8, color=c)
ax.set_xlabel('LONRF3 residue'); ax.set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax.set_ylim(0,110)
ax.set_title('AlphaFold confidence, human LONRF3 (Q496Y0)')
im=axes[1].imshow(pae, cmap='viridis_r', vmin=0, vmax=31)
for (a,b),c in [((158,195),'#d62728'),((467,504),'#1f77b4')]:
    axes[1].axhline(a,color=c,lw=0.5); axes[1].axhline(b,color=c,lw=0.5)
    axes[1].axvline(a,color=c,lw=0.5); axes[1].axvline(b,color=c,lw=0.5)
axes[1].set_title('Predicted aligned error (A)'); axes[1].set_xlabel('residue'); axes[1].set_ylabel('residue')
plt.colorbar(im,ax=axes[1],fraction=0.046)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
